A '''complex number''' is the sum of a [[real number]] with an [[imaginary number]].

== Formal definition ==

$$
a+bi,\,  a,b \in \mathbb{R}
$$

is a '''complex number''', where $i$ is the [[imaginary number#Formal_definition|imaginary unit]].

The set of all complex numbers can be denoted by $\mathbb{C}$.
